summary.headline: Ancient Astronomical Books
summary.text: Editorial preface records manuscript and edition sources for the Speculum Astronomicum, including Parisinus 7440, Munich Clm. 18175, the Lyon edition, and studies by Moritz Steinschneider. Chapter II begins a catalogue of ancient astronomical books, starting with Nemroth’s Sphaera caeli and mentioning Ptolemy.
